title: TradingView Squeeze Momentum — Volatility Compression Release MVE
novelty_statement: Tests relative volatility compression and subsequent expansion. This is distinct from CIGL_BB_01 mean-reversion, which trades price outside Bollinger bands.
contamination_map: TradingView public Squeeze Momentum description and open-source defaults were visible before freeze.
Existing Crypto Lab classic-indicator work and Donchian/trend work were visible before freeze.
No TVSQZ-001 market outcomes were inspected before this freeze.

squeeze_definition.momentum: LazyBear linreg construction reproduced independently from OHLC; sign only is used in directional gate.

stage_a_mechanism.future_rv4: sum of squared 1h log returns over the next 4 completed bars
stage_a_mechanism.expected_rv4_from_trailing20: 4 * mean squared 1h log return over the trailing 20 completed returns available at event time

stage_b_directional.exit: close of fourth bar after entry bar begins (i+4 close)

if_both_pass: DISCOVERY_SURVIVES_ONLY. 2024 remains sealed pending a separate prospective OOS authorization/freeze.
